shots.title: 行前準備：核准出差單、實際里程截圖與 ETag 明細
shots.chapter: 概念鏡 01｜出差出發前先備齊三樣佐證
shots.flow_prompt: Clean modern corporate 3D animation, smooth camera tracking a silver sedan driving along a sunny Taiwan highway passing underneath a glowing blue eTag electronic toll gantry, transitioning smoothly to arriving cleanly at a modern steel material factory gate with a digital route map display, bright daylight, crisp professional explainer video style, 4k.
shots.narration: 歡迎收看 BPM 私車公用報銷快速導覽！開車出差報帳前，先備好三樣資料：第一是本人核准的出差登記單，第二是用 Google 地圖截下當次實際去回程路線圖，看實際跑了多少公里就依實際里程計算，第三則是遠通 eTag 實際扣款明細。
shots.subtitle: 出差三寶：本人核准出差單 ＋ 個人實際去／回程路線截圖 ＋ ETag 實際扣款明細
key_points: 複用已生成 Flow 實片

shots.title: 進入 EPM 一般費用報銷單並選取本人出差單號
shots.chapter: 概念鏡 02｜開啟表單並帶入當次實際出差單
shots.flow_prompt: Clean modern corporate 3D explainer animation, smooth zoom toward a glowing glass desktop monitor displaying a sleek blue BPM expense portal icon, then smoothly opening floating translucent trip selector cards where an animated cursor highlights and selects the employee's matching business trip record, crisp clean corporate tech aesthetic, soft studio lighting, 4k.
shots.narration: 接著進到鼎新 BPM，點開 EPM 裡面的『一般費用報銷單』，確認表頭的公司別、部門跟日期。然後到費用明細點選『出差登記單號』旁邊的查詢鈕，從清單裡選出你這趟實際出差的單號，讓系統自動帶入日期、地點跟出差事由，千萬別選錯張喔！
shots.subtitle: 進入 EPM 一般費用報銷單 → 點選查詢鈕，選取你這趟實際出差的單號
key_points: 選取本人當次出差單號

shots.title: 雙軌分流鐵律：私車里程 A05 與 ETag 通行費 A07 分開列
shots.chapter: 概念鏡 03｜私車公用 (A05) 與 ETag (A07) 絕不合併
shots.flow_prompt: Clean modern corporate 3D infographic animation, starting with a glowing mileage odometer and sedan icon flowing into a blue left track labeled A05, while a glowing highway eTag wave splits smoothly into a separate green right track labeled A07, emphasizing two distinct parallel glass cards floating cleanly side by side in a dark slate studio, crisp 4k.
shots.narration: 填費用明細時，最重要的原則就是『分開列示』！私車公用里程費選 A05，依你自己實際跑的公里數與公司核定單價計算登打，並備註實際車牌號碼；而高速公路的 eTag 通行費一定要另外新增一筆 A07，照遠通實際扣款金額填報，絕不能跟里程費混在一起。
shots.subtitle: 雙軌分流：A05 私車里程費（依實際公里與車號）vs A07 eTag（依實扣金額獨立列示）
key_points: A05 私車公用依實際里程
A07 eTag 依實扣獨立列

shots.title: 非私車公用情境：高鐵 (A01) 與停車費 (A06)
shots.chapter: 概念鏡 04｜搭高鐵與停車費依實際票據獨立申報
shots.flow_prompt: Clean modern corporate 3D animation transition, starting at a bright high-speed rail station platform as a sleek streamlined bullet train arrives, smoothly gliding to a modern parking garage exit kiosk with a rising green barrier gate and glowing receipt card, bright professional explainer style, 4k.
shots.narration: 如果你這趟出差改搭高鐵，或是有產生額外的停車費，記得要選 A01 高鐵或 A06 停車費。而且畫面上的數字都只是範例，報銷時請一律依照手中車票、電子發票或停車收據上的實際金額與發票號碼來登打喔！
shots.subtitle: 一般交通費：高鐵選 A01、停車費選 A06，皆依實際票據金額與發票號碼登打
key_points: 複用已生成 Flow 實片
A01 高鐵 / A06 停車費
依實際票據勿照抄範例

shots.title: 總額對齊、附件上傳與「先儲存再送出」
shots.chapter: 概念鏡 05｜確認明細合計一致、附件可開、完成送簽
shots.flow_prompt: Clean modern corporate 3D motion graphics animation, starting with floating invoice and map screenshot documents flying neatly into a glowing digital upload folder beside a balanced scale icon, smoothly transforming into three illuminated emerald milestone pills lighting up in sequence: Save, Submit, and Approved Ticket Badge, crisp dark tech studio, 4k.
shots.narration: 全部實際費用都新增完畢後，請先檢查所有明細加總是否等於表頭報銷總金額，再把出差單、路線截圖、eTag 與發票附件全部上傳，確認點得開。送簽前先按一次『儲存』確認沒有紅字提醒，再正式按下『送出』並留存 BPM 單號！
shots.subtitle: 明細合計＝表頭總額 → 上傳並檢查所有附件 → 先按儲存無誤再送出簽核

shots.title: 紙本正本繳交：申請人 → 人事核對 → 會計審核
shots.chapter: 概念鏡 06｜實體正本交件流程與最後審核
shots.flow_prompt: Clean modern corporate office animation, starting with an employee neatly organizing printed BPM expense forms and paper receipts on a desk, smoothly transitioning to a three-step glass workflow visualization showing Applicant handing originals to HR for verification stamp, then forwarding to Accounting for final approval, warm bright office lighting, crisp 4k.
shots.narration: 最後提醒，線上送簽完成不代表結束喔！請把申請單印出來，連同實際發生的發票、收據正本、路線截圖與計算資料一起交給人事單位核對；等人事確認正本與線上內容無誤後，才會正式轉交給會計審核與撥款。
shots.subtitle: 交件鐵律：申請人備妥實際憑證正本 → 交由人事核對無誤 → 人事轉交會計最後審核
key_points: 複用已生成 Flow 實片
